dialogues.speaker: Kimura's Message
dialogues.text: "Recently, Madam Kujou let it slip that the Drumalong Festival on Amakane Island was quite interesting. My coworkers and I got curious, so we stopped by after work to check it out."

dialogues.speaker: Kimura's Message
dialogues.text: "We were more than a little surprised to find that it was the work of the Arataki Gang, who we evicted from Ritou just a few days ago. So they actually pulled it off, they're hosting a festival. Good for them, I say."

dialogues.speaker: Kimura's Message
dialogues.text: "Sure, it's a very small-scale festival, but it's a first step. Keep at it, you guys. I hope to see more of this from you in the future."
